## Question to try and answer/work through and the data with it

How do bill length and the mass differ among the penguins sex

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

## Loading and prepping the data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-r-penguins
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins_clean <- penguins |>
  filter(
    !is.na(species),
    !is.na(bill_length_mm),
    !is.na(bill_depth_mm),
    !is.na(sex)
  )

head(penguins_clean)
```

## Plotting the bill length

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-penguin-bills
#| fig-cap: "Bill length and bill depth by Palmer Penguin species and sex."
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  penguins_clean,
  aes(
    x = bill_length_mm,
    y = bill_depth_mm,
    colour = species,
    shape = sex
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin bill dimensions vary by species",
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)",
    colour = "Species",
    shape = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
